FINDINGS.claim: Velocity caps calibrated for span-averaged velocity (DEP_VEL_MAX=1.4, "divers never sprint") and a per-second jitter allowance (JITTER_C=0.012) are applied to INSTANTANEOUS single-frame velocity. At 60 fps normal detector box jitter on a rotating airborne diver exceeds the cap.
FINDINGS.evidence: Mean flight speed ~0.5-1.0 norm/s but per-frame GT speed oscillates 0-5 norm/s; camera flow ~0 (not a compensation artifact). V3 gate blocks subject adjacent pairs 2341 21/55, 1040 5/30, 2541 5/23, 2387 2/27 (takeoff link). r5._gate_ok rejects subject flight links 1040 41%, 2169 55%, 2341 42%, 2353 32%, 2541 24% (clip-wide 6-25%).

FINDINGS.claim: Pool is harvested only from paths alive at the LAST frame of the clip; flight hypotheses found mid-beam are pruned or die before harvest.
FINDINGS.evidence: 2169: subject in-beam post-prune on 86% (frozen) / 100% (strict) of flight anchor frames, 3 starts carry it through the whole window, yet final beam/pool best = 0.184. 2341 strict: 100% in-beam, pool 0.0.

FINDINGS.claim: Dynamic (mover) slots rank by cost - W_DYN*age*min(maxspeed,0.8)/0.8 with maxspeed the max-ever EWMA speed: one spike latches a permanent bonus that grows with age; sparse hijack/jitter paths evict the real subject.
FINDINGS.evidence: 676 start 120 frame 131: 9 on-subject hypotheses pre-prune, 0 post; dynamic occupants have 5-7 obs over 11 frames with maxspeed ~0.8 vs subject 0.54; ~3.5 key-unit gap from the age x maxspeed term. Mean mover-latch fraction in flight windows 0.42-0.82.

FINDINGS.claim: Starts seed only top-12 confidence + 6 movers at 30-frame strata; the airborne diver is rarely seeded and never re-acquired.
FINDINGS.evidence: Beam trace: 71/94 start-windows (frozen authority) never place a hypothesis on the subject during flight; whole-beam snapshot harvest on 1040 still only 0.07-0.14.

FINDINGS.claim: Hurdle subject "GT" is evaluator-seeded and candidate-snapped: 1040 and 2541 have ZERO HUMAN_GT anchors (VISUAL_EVALUATOR only); other hurdle chains are 2-5 human seeds linearly interpolated and snapped to D5 candidates; unresolved frames AMBIGUOUS_GT are excluded from denominators; one not_visible HUMAN seed (2169 t=6.2833) is used as a position seed.
FINDINGS.evidence: Median anchor-to-floor distance 0.0000 on all hurdle dives (union=1.0 by construction). 2169: 28/80 flight frames AMBIGUOUS (all 28 of the clip); mid-flight snaps at match_dist 0.055-0.079 > RADIUS 0.06 on 2341/2541. Human flight seeds: 1040 0, 2169 5, 2341 2, 2353 4, 2541 0.

FINDINGS.claim: extend_core backward prediction double-negates (vx=-vel0 with dt_sign<0) so it extrapolates forward in time; forward seed velocity mixes raw with compensated coordinates; velocity never updated.
FINDINGS.evidence: Source inspection; corrected in candidate BF-B (no retained gain, see candidates).

FINDINGS.claim: Excursion term (running max-min) is monotone in window length while penalties are means, so cores saturate at CORE_MAX_S=3.0 s and pack ~1.2 s flights with 1.8 s of surrounding content.

STAGE_DEFINITIONS:
DIVE_ANALYZER_FLIGHT_PATH_CANDIDATE_RECALL_AUDIT_V1.

Audit / localization only. Frozen V3 (F0 + F1) is executed UNCHANGED via
flight_anchored_traj_v3.infer; pass-through wrappers record intermediate
stages (per-start final beam, decoded pool). No V3 constant or function is
modified. HUMAN subject/event GT enters only in the evaluation section,
after every stage for a dive is frozen in memory.

Stages (actual implementation stages):
  S0  RAW_FLOOR_UNION        full D5 floor (conf>=0.001, cap 200), any cand
  S1  CAPPED_FRAME_LATTICE   build_frame_lattice (50 conf + 10 movers)
  S2  GRAPH_ORACLE           best path through S1 nodes under V3's exact
                             transition function (gates, caps, NULL<=0.30 s),
                             without search restrictions (start strata, seed
                             caps, fan-out, beam). Evaluation-only; adds no
                             node or edge.
  S3a BEAM_FINAL             each start's final live beam (<=64), pre-triage
  S3  F0_POOL_PATHS          decoded pool (POOL_PER_START triage, dedup)
  S3c F0_POOL_CORES          best-Q core per pool path (the ranked objects)
  S4  F0_TOPK_CORES          diversity-deduped Q order, first FINAL_TOP_K
  S5  F1_EXTENDED_CANDIDATES in V3 == S6 (extend_core runs on top-K only);
                             an evaluation-only counterfactual applies the
                             frozen extend_core to EVERY pool core (S5cf)
  S6  F1_FINAL_TOPK          retained V3 tracks
